description: Prompts designed to spark creativity, storytelling, and imaginative content generation

prompts.title: Story Opening
prompts.prompt: Write an engaging opening paragraph for a [genre] story that begins with: "[opening line]". Create intrigue and establish the tone.

prompts.title: Character Development
prompts.prompt: Create a detailed character profile for a [role/archetype] character named [name]. Include: backstory, personality traits, motivations, fears, and a character arc outline.

prompts.title: World Building
prompts.prompt: Create a detailed world description for a [type of world] setting. Include: geography, culture, political system, technology level, and unique features that make this world distinctive.

prompts.title: Poetry Composition
prompts.prompt: Write a [type of poem] about [subject]. Use [specific technique or style] and ensure the poem evokes [desired emotion].

prompts.title: Dialogue Writing
prompts.prompt: Write a dialogue between [character A] and [character B] who are [relationship/context]. The conversation should reveal [hidden information/character development] while maintaining natural speech patterns.

prompts.title: Plot Twist Development
prompts.prompt: Take the following story premise: [premise] and develop three unexpected plot twists that recontextualize earlier events. Explain how each twist changes the story's meaning.

prompts.title: Metaphor Generation
prompts.prompt: Generate 10 original metaphors for [abstract concept]. Each metaphor should approach the concept from a different angle and evoke different emotional responses.

prompts.title: Screenplay Scene
prompts.prompt: Write a screenplay scene for [situation] featuring [characters]. Include proper screenplay formatting, action descriptions, dialogue, and subtext.

prompts.title: Advertising Slogan
prompts.prompt: Create 5 memorable advertising slogans for [product/service]. Each slogan should appeal to a different target demographic or highlight a different benefit.

prompts.title: Alternate History
prompts.prompt: Create an alternate history scenario where [historical divergence point]. Describe how this change would affect [specific aspects of society/history] up to the present day.

prompts.title: Song Lyrics
prompts.prompt: Write lyrics for a [genre] song about [theme]. Include verse-chorus structure, a bridge, and use [specific lyrical technique].

prompts.title: Flash Fiction
prompts.prompt: Write a complete flash fiction story in exactly [word count] words about [topic]. The story should have a clear beginning, middle, and twist ending.

prompts.title: Satire Writing
prompts.prompt: Write a satirical piece about [topic/issue]. Use irony, exaggeration, and humor to critique while making a serious underlying point.

prompts.title: Children's Story
prompts.prompt: Write a children's story for ages [age range] about [theme/character]. Include a clear moral lesson, engaging language, and a gentle, age-appropriate tone.

prompts.title: Mystery Setup
prompts.prompt: Create the setup for a mystery story involving [crime/situation]. Include the crime scene, initial clues, suspects with motives, and a red herring.

prompts.title: Science Fiction Concept
prompts.prompt: Develop a science fiction concept based on [scientific principle or technology]. Explore its implications for society, potential conflicts, and how it changes human experience.

prompts.title: Monologue Writing
prompts.prompt: Write a dramatic monologue for a [type of character] who is [emotional state/situation]. The monologue should reveal character depth and include a turning point.

prompts.title: Brand Story
prompts.prompt: Create a compelling brand story for [company/product]. Include origin story, mission, values, and emotional connection with the target audience.

prompts.title: Comedy Sketch
prompts.prompt: Write a comedy sketch about [premise]. Include setup, escalation, and a punchline. Create distinct characters with conflicting perspectives.

prompts.title: Descriptive Passage
prompts.prompt: Write a vivid descriptive passage of [setting/object] using all five senses. Focus on showing rather than telling, and create an immersive experience for the reader.
